title: Stock Administrator
description:

title: Senior Manager, Global Indirect Tax
description:
Discord has a highly engaged community of millions of daily active users who use the platform for many different reasons, but there’s one thing that nearly everyone does: play video games. Discord plays a uniquely important role in the future of gaming, and we are focused on making it easier and more fun for people to hang out before, during, and after playing games.
 As a senior manager, you’ll lead global indirect tax strategy and advisory for new products, evolving business models and laws, and enterprise-wide initiatives. You’ll be a trusted strategic advisor to teams across the business, making sure indirect tax requirements, risks, and opportunities are considered early and thoughtfully, not after launch. This role is about shaping decisions: translating complex sales and use tax, VAT, GST, digital services tax, and other indirect tax issues into clear, practical guidance, and owning the work from strategy through execution.
 What You'll Be Doing
 Own all technical areas of global indirect tax and serve as the lead researcher on complex issues such as taxability, sourcing, and emerging business models. Own positions end to end: research the law, form a view, document it in well-reasoned memos, and stand behind it with leadership, auditors, and external advisors.
 Lead indirect tax strategy for new products, monetization models, and market entries (digital goods, virtual currency, marketplaces, advertising, subscriptions). Partner with Product, Legal, Finance, Accounting, and Engineering from early design through go-live.
 Monitor legislative and regulatory changes globally, assess the impact on the business, and turn them into actionable recommendations.
 Analyze the indirect tax implications of inter company transactions, new entity structures, and acquisitions. Partner with Direct Tax to recommend approaches that balance tax efficiency, risk, and operational feasibility.

title: Senior Statisticien RWE
description:
Join Excelya , where Audacity, Care and Energy define who we are and how we work. We believe in creating ambitious solutions and fostering an inclusive environment where collaboration and individual growth go hand in hand.
 This role offers an exciting opportunity to join a Statistics team overseeing Real-World Evidence (RWE), non-interventional, and Secondary Use of Data (SUD) studies. You will provide statistical leadership, review study protocols and analysis plans, supervise external service providers, ensure the quality and timely delivery of statistical outputs, and work closely with cross-functional teams to support evidence generation and regulatory reporting
 Key Responsibilities :
 - Review study synopses and protocols, including sample size calculations, study design, endpoints, and statistical methodologies.
 - Oversee statistical deliverables from external service providers, including Statistical Analysis Plans (SAPs), TFLs, and interim analyses.
 - Monitor study statistical milestones and track operational progress through vendor dashboards.
 - Ensure the timely delivery of statistical outputs and analysis datasets in compliance with Ipsen quality standards.
 - Perform quality control of statistical analyses, including SAS programming and programming validation activities.
 - Review clinical study reports (CSRs) and all external communications related to study results and analyses.
 - Collaborate closely with cross-functional stakeholders, including Biometry, Clinical Operations, Medical teams, and external partners.
 - Ensure complete and accurate maintenance of study documentation, including accountability for eTMF completion.
 Requirements
 At Excelya, we encourage everyone to be bold, challenge themselves, and unlock their full potential. We are looking for professionals who share our values and are eager to grow in a dynamic and stimulating environment.

title: Law Enforcement Engagement Lead - LATAM
description:
Airbnb was born in 2007 when two hosts welcomed three guests to their San Francisco home, and has since grown to over 5 million hosts who have welcomed over 2 billion guest arrivals in almost every country across the globe. Every day, hosts offer unique stays and experiences that make it possible for guests to connect with communities in a more authentic way.
 The Community You Will Join:
 The Global Safety & Risk Management (GSRM) organization protects Airbnb's global community through proactive risk management, investigations, and real-time response to critical safety incidents. GSRM's 24/7 operations span Global Threat and Law Enforcement Operations, Global Investigations (GI), and Insider Threat Investigations (ITI).
 The Difference You Will Make:
 The Law Enforcement Engagement Regional Lead for Latin America (LATAM), covering Mexico, Central America, the Caribbean, and South America, is responsible for driving strategic bilateral and multilateral communication, cooperation, and collaboration efforts with law enforcement entities and domestic security services located and/or operating in LATAM to protect Airbnb equities and stakeholders from criminal and serious safety-related threats in close coordination with other Airbnb GSRM teams.
 A Typical Day:
 Lead, develop, and manage Airbnb efforts to cultivate trusted and reliable relationships with law enforcement partners in the LATAM region to safeguard the Airbnb platform and community.
 Lead and promote effective information exchange and collaboration with regional law enforcement on criminal threat and life safety matters that endanger the Airbnb community.
 Lead, develop, and maintain effective working relationships with law enforcement and government authorities in LATAM by building partnerships and coalitions through liaison with international law enforcement organizations (e.g., UNODC, INTERPOL, AMERIPOL, OAS, the Alliance for Security, Justice and Development, IACP, etc.)
